links.outcome: LLM therapeutic communication quality in simulated multi-turn mental health conversations, including AI-specific problematic patterns
links.effect: All 12 LLMs scored below 4 out of 6 on average, with particular weaknesses in problematic AI-specific communication patterns; performance worsened with longer interactions and severe symptoms.
links.quote: Then, we evaluate 12 state-of-the-art LLMs and show that all models struggle, scoring below 4 out of 6, on average, with particular weaknesses in problematic AI-specific patterns of communication.

unlisted_practices: Automated multi-turn patient-simulation benchmark with LLM judges validated against licensed clinical psychologist ratings for evaluating mental health chatbots

screen.reason: Evaluates multiple LLMs on simulated multi-turn mental health therapy interactions using automated patient simulation and expert-aligned evaluation criteria.
